title: Tool output issue: read_file — pre-creation probe of absent file recorded as tool error
description: During run 18eadcc3-b142-4096-b3ac-5cbde9dc570c, read_file was called on .moeb/config.json before the file was created, to determine whether to merge or create it. The failed call was recorded by the kernel as a tool error, causing the tool-errors rubric criterion to fail permanently (kernel-authoritative; cannot be overridden via acknowledged_failures). The file was subsequently created correctly. Workaround: proceeded with unconditional create; no data was lost.
proposed_resolution: Introduce a file_exists moeb tool (or an exists_only: true flag on read_file) that returns a boolean without recording a tool error on file absence. This allows agents to check file existence as a precondition without poisoning the tool-errors rubric record.
